public_key_limits.reclamation_rule: Failed or interrupted generations retain their debt until observed cleanup; elapsed time alone releases no token. Successful temporary-key deletion is verified absent before its class slot is released.

execution_union.gateway_lifecycle: one StatefulSet member, OnDelete; replaces the prior gateway executor

One65536-byte fresh blob fits;65537 bytes or a second distinct blob identity rejects.
One71-byte layer link fits; changed extent or a second distinct link identity rejects.
Sixteen4096-byte metadata keys fit;4097 bytes or a seventeenth simultaneous key rejects.
Data and index have independent128-key limits; each1048576-byte extent fits and1048577 rejects.
Failed and interrupted writes consume the same writer's durable3/2/1 token inventory. A restart must preserve both committed key reservations and failed debt.
Every mutating multipart stage requires a persisted reservation and an owned upload id, with one bounded part; unsupported extra parts or foreign copy sources reject before backend mutation.
A successful response or upload id is delivered only after durable state commit; deletion releases its slot only after backend absence is observed.
